decisions.reason: We would keep the coolant pressure booster system because its continued presence suggests results are not falling below aspiration levels, it fits the core coolant-management offer, and our size gives enough slack for further scaling.

We would keep the coolant cleaning centrifuge since it remains closely aligned with our established business and there is still no clear sign of a performance shortfall that would trigger reallocation of resources.
We would keep the coolant nozzles line because the multiple models broaden system sales, appear to have passed the most uncertain launch phase, and do not show an obvious gap versus aspirations.

We would keep the scraper belt chip conveyor, but with continued monitoring, because it is somewhat more adjacent and would be a plausible target for problemistic search if its results lag our internal or peer benchmarks.

We would keep the hinged belt chip conveyor for now because it has survived the early market test, yet as a more adjacent conveyor product it still carries a higher withdrawal risk than the core coolant-related launches.
